day.headline: Sensex slipped 126 points for a fourth straight fall as a midcap and smallcap rout (−2.2% and −2.9%) and Swiggy's 16% crash overshadowed IT gains ahead of Infosys results.
day.summary: Benchmarks opened firmer but turned lower as West Asia tensions, high crude and an AI-led global equity sell-off hit risk appetite; India VIX rose about 7%. The broader market was hit far harder than the Nifty: only 312 NSE stocks rose against 2,262 that fell, and 102 Nifty 500 stocks hit 52-week closing lows. FIIs turned small net buyers (₹888 cr) and DIIs bought ₹3,235 cr; after hours Infosys cut its FY27 revenue guidance, and on Saturday Kotak Mahindra Bank reported a 29% profit jump.

items.title: Sensex falls for fourth day; midcaps −2.21%, smallcaps −2.94% in broad sell-off
items.why: Mid- and smallcap fund NAVs took a much bigger hit than large-cap and index funds today; Smallcap 100 is down about 8% in seven sessions. Geojit's Vinod Nair cited valuation concerns, unwinding of leveraged positions, surging crude and an AI-led global equity sell-off; India VIX (the fear gauge) rose about 7% to 16.86.

items.title: Infosys Q2: profit +6% to ₹7,823 cr, but FY27 revenue guidance cut to 1–2%
items.why: Infosys is among the largest holdings across large-cap, flexi-cap, IT and Nifty index funds, so the guidance cut could weigh on IT stocks when markets reopen on 26/10. Revenue rose about 11% YoY to ₹49,244 cr; constant-currency growth guidance was cut from 1.5–3% to 1–2% on a 'challenging demand environment', margin guidance of 20–22% kept, and an interim dividend of ₹26 declared (record date 03/11/2026, payout 11/11/2026).

items.title: Kotak Mahindra Bank Q2 (reported Saturday 24/10): standalone profit +29% to ₹4,212 cr
items.why: Kotak is widely held by large-cap, banking and index funds, and a beat on profit with better asset quality supports bank-heavy portfolios. Reported on Saturday 24/10: NII (net interest income) up 16% to ₹8,459 cr, but NIM (lending margin) fell to 4.31% from 4.54%; gross NPA improved to 1.04% from 1.39%, and consolidated profit rose 26% to ₹5,645 cr.

items.title: Swiggy hits lower circuit, down about 16% after Q2 as quick-commerce worries mount
items.why: This was the biggest drag on midcap indices, so midcap and new-age/consumption funds holding Swiggy felt it directly. The net loss narrowed YoY to ₹922 cr but widened from ₹792 cr in Q1, the adjusted EBITDA loss widened to ₹760 cr, and brokerages cut targets on Instamart profitability; the stock closed at ₹176 (−16.75% on NSE).

items.title: Jio Platforms IPO (₹1,065–1,119 band) closes; QIB-led oversubscription
items.why: Many AMCs could take anchor or QIB allocations in India's largest IPO, and its listing may pull flows into Reliance-related stocks. Chittorgarh reports a final 21.36x overall (QIB 67.15x, NII 13.99x, retail 2.76x); Analytics Insight reported 12.25x at its update, so treat the final figure as unconfirmed until the exchange data is checked. Issue size is given as ₹30,187.65 cr to ₹30,213 cr; allotment was due 26/10 and listing 28/10.

items.title: AMFI September data: about 4.54 lakh new MF investors; SIP inflow ₹32,490 cr
items.why: SIP money held steady through the correction, which supports the case for continuing SIPs. Industry folios reached 28.62 crore (up 14% YoY), outstanding SIP accounts 10.89 crore, SIP AUM ₹17.86 lakh cr (about 21% of industry AUM), and SIF distributor registrations a record 1,475.

items.title: Motilal Oswal launches Multi Asset-Omni FoF; ABSL AMC H1 profit +2%; UBS takes 4.8% of 360 ONE WAM
items.why: New multi-asset NFO option for clients: it invests in equity and debt funds plus gold and silver ETFs, is benchmarked 60/30/5/5 (Nifty 500 TRI / short-duration debt / gold / silver), and closes 04/11/2026 (min ₹500, 1% exit load within 90 days). Separately, ABSL AMC's H1 FY27 profit rose 2% to ₹530.5 cr with equity QAAUM up 9% to ₹2.09 lakh cr, and UBS converted warrants into a 4.8% stake in 360 ONE WAM.
